title: WaterScience verified support knowledge base - research prototype
intended_use: Retrieval source for AI-drafted customer-support replies that require human approval. It is not a policy engine and must not authorize refunds, replacements, warranty claims or medical outcomes.
guardrails: Return only facts whose product applicability matches the identified SKU or product family.
When the purchase channel is not WaterScience.in, do not apply the WaterScience.in shipping or returns policy.
Do not promise health, hair or skin outcomes. The current replacement-cartridge page itself says CLEO is not a medical device and hair fall can have other causes.
When source records conflict, say that the information needs confirmation and create a human-review task.
For leaks, electrical/plumbing risks, damaged products, warranty determinations, returns/refunds, or suspected safety issues: collect evidence and escalate.
Negative compatibility rule: PURO HFS-625 is a self-cleaning faucet with no replacement cartridge; do not recommend PURO HFF cartridges for it.
Negative rule: RENO Cygnus uses softener salt/regeneration and is not a replacement-cartridge product. Keep salt and maintenance/service information strictly separate from cartridge recommendations.
Keep 10-inch and 20-inch RIO mainline cartridge mappings model-specific rather than universal (e.g., RIO-MLF-119 uses RIO-RC-119). Do not generalize cartridges across different mainline models.
Unverified mapping: Do not add or provide a confirmed KTF Wide/FLO-KTF-723 ceramic cartridge mapping; mark it as unverified/pending vendor confirmation and avoid definitive recommendations.

CLEO_SFU_717.name: CLEO Shower & Tap Filter for Hard Water
CLEO_SFU_717.applicability: Exact CLEO SFU-717 only unless another CLEO model is explicitly named by an applicable source.

verified_facts.fact: Fits metal-threaded taps, showers and hand showers; named tap sizes are 22 mm, 24 mm and 28 mm. Does not fit plastic taps.
Municipal/Metro is described for chlorine and moderate hardness; Borewell/Tanker for high hardness with no chlorine.
The product page recommends cartridge replacement every six months, varying with usage and water quality.
The product page says tap and shower filters do not reduce TDS.
The page says the product installs in under three minutes and includes an installation kit; customers can use its linked video or contact support.

conditional_guidance.condition: Customer asks which cartridge to select
conditional_guidance.action: Draft a recommendation only when the documented condition matches; otherwise ask for clarification or human review.

conditional_guidance.condition: Customer says TDS did not fall
conditional_guidance.action: Explain that the official product page says TDS is not reduced. Do not diagnose water safety or promise performance.
State that the current cartridge FAQ attributes a drop to sediment blocking and refers to reverse flushing; direct to official support/video for the exact current procedure. Escalate if unresolved.
conditional_guidance.uncertainty: The legacy manual has more steps but is not current-domain verified.

conflicts.safe_action: Do not answer automatically. Flag a documentation conflict and request support confirmation.

4-6 months and separately every six months

CLEO_REPLACEMENT_CARTRIDGE.name: CLEO Replacement Cartridge for Shower & Tap Filters

verified_facts.fact: The page names compatible CLEO models: SFU-717, SFU-1020, SFM-419, SFA-520, SFS-423, SFR-923, SFR-519, Kiddo Duo and SFW-815.
Metro/Municipal: chlorine and hardness, TDS below 800 ppm. Borewell/Tanker: high hardness with no chlorine, TDS up to 1800 ppm.
The FAQ says to insert the replacement red side up and run water for a couple of minutes after replacement to flush carbon dust.

escalate_when: model is not on compatibility list

IRIS_WMF_325.name: Washing Machine Filter for Hard Water - IRIS-WMF-325

verified_facts.fact: The page says the supplied hose adapter supports all brands' automatic top- and front-load machines; inlet connects to 1/2-inch BSP and 1/2-inch or 24-mm externally threaded taps.
Replacement guidance: top-load 3-4 months and front-load 4-6 months, depending on machine and water quality.
Product page lists a one-year warranty.

KTF_WIDE_CERAMIC.name: KTF Kitchen Tap Extender with Sediment and Dust Filter - Wide ceramic cartridge

verified_facts.fact: Wide variant page lists 20, 22 and 24 mm male/female aerators and hot-water compatibility up to 40°C.
The page lists tap filter, aerator, adapter, washers and two replacement cartridges.

Standalone ceramic replacement cartridge mapping for KTF Wide / FLO-KTF-723 is UNVERIFIED and pending vendor confirmation. The assistant must NOT make a definitive cartridge recommendation for this model until confirmed.

Also, this product page shows a Mini variant; do not transfer Wide specifications to Mini without separate evidence.

RENO_CYGNUS.name: RENO Cygnus Water Softener

verified_facts.fact: Product page lists the softener, prefilter casing/sediment filter, connecting accessories, stand, starter salt and hardness kit; input/output plumbing material is not included.
Product page lists two years for valve and electronics; physical damage is not covered.

Negative rule: RENO Cygnus is an ion-exchange water softener that uses softener salt pellets/tablets for resin regeneration and is NOT a replacement-cartridge product. Keep softener salt consumables and maintenance/service information strictly separate from cartridge recommendations.

escalate_when: cartridge replacement inquiry (softener uses salt regeneration, not cartridges)

warranty.applicability: Use to explain the documented process; human team decides eligibility.

facts.fact: Warranty requires registration within seven days with serial number or a valid invoice; the company may request photos/videos.
CLEO shower-filter cartridges have a 90-day manufacturing-defect warranty, excluding sediment choking and prolonged disuse among other exclusions.

returns_and_refunds.applicability: WaterScience website purchases only. Never apply to Amazon, quick-commerce, retail or marketplace orders without the relevant channel policy.

facts.fact: CLEO website purchases have a stated 60-day return policy; other website products generally have seven days, subject to stated conditions.
The policy names damaged/defective items or a different item received as return conditions and requests photo/video evidence for damage or difference.
Eligible refund initiation is stated as within seven working days after the applicable request or post-delivery pickup; a Rs. 99 pickup charge may apply.

shipping.applicability: WaterScience website orders only; estimate, not a guarantee.

facts.fact: Most orders are stated to dispatch in 2-3 business days, then take 3-4 business days in Bengaluru or 5-6 elsewhere in India, subject to location and delivery-partner factors.
General after-sales support: care@waterscience.in, 1800-121-0599, WhatsApp 9148545840; Monday-Saturday, 09:30-20:30.
The returns page gives Mon-Sat, 09:30-18:30 for a return request call.
